handle_follow_on_card_control_h1_2020_20.classification_evidence: Positive control, recorded so the instrument's resolution on this population is on the record. It bounds nothing by itself: it resolves at the perfect-foresight magnitude only. An interval containing zero is never grounds to close; this cell is category 3. No admissible closing ground applies: the sign is not resolved in BOTH the week- and season-blocked bootstraps, split-half reliability was not the question, and the matching perfect-foresight control resolves only at the oracle magnitude, not at the size a real handle effect would have.
